thread:
ava (docs): Heads-up: I'm drafting a short SG region availability blurb and updating the localization table to call out data residency guarantees for Singapore. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1301. Need quick checks from platform/security/intl.

noah (intl): Pinged. Two translation notes: 1) zh-SG vs zh-SG variants? Let's keep zh-Hans with region footnote. 2) We'll need separate copy for 'latency vs residency' so customers understand Hosted SG is low-latency but not necessarily 'data residency' unless they choose Dedicated/Private.

raj (platform): Clarification: Hosted endpoints deployed in the ap-sg region are available for Hosted API (low-latency) but we only guarantee data residency for Dedicated/Private deployments in SG due to contract/KYC flows. Suggest phrase: 'Hosted API in Singapore improves latency for APAC customers; data residency guarantees are available with Redwood Dedicated or Private deployments.'

claire (security): Also add a line about customer-managed keys. For Dedicated/Private in SG, customers can bring KMS/HSM; for Hosted we retain log metadata for incident investigation but do not retain raw customer inputs past retention window. I'll draft a short sentence for the PR.

tess (devex): Small SDK snippet change request: current examples use 'X-Region: ap-sg' header. For Hosted usage in SG we recommend setting endpoint host instead of header to avoid confusion with routing policies. Proposed snippet for PR: ```js
// Hosted (ap-sg)
fetch('https://sg.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${REDWOOD_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ messages })
})

// Dedicated/Private (region header)
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${REDWOOD_KEY}', 'X-Region': 'ap-sg' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ messages })
})
``` Any objections?

raj (platform): That looks good. Note to add: sending 'X-Region: ap-sg' to public Hosted endpoints will be ignored (or may route to nearest global region). Let's call out expected behavior: header only used for Dedicated/Private routing; Hosted requests should use region-specific host.

claire (security): Also include a short note about certificate validation and regional CA differences for private partners in SG. I'll paste a one-liner for the PR: "For Dedicated or Private deployments in Singapore, customers may be required to configure TLS certificates and trust chains per partner requirements."

ava (docs): Great. Noah: can you add a TODO for translations (en-sg + zh-Hans + ms)? We should also remove an internal footnote that points to the old partner onboarding doc (internal.redwood/sg-partners) and replace it with the public partner page when ready.

noah (intl): Will do. Also flagging a shorter copy for the quickstart so docs don't get long: 'SG Hosted: low-latency; Dedicated/Private: residency & KMS.' We'll add the longer legal/security paragraph under an expandable section.

tess (devex): Quick UX ask: update the Console region selector screenshot to include 'Singapore (ap-sg)' option. I can export a new screenshot once copy is merged.

ava (docs): Plan: 1) Ava updates PR with endpoint/snippet and expandable security paragraph. 2) Claire drops the approved security sentence. 3) Noah wires up i18n TODOs. 4) Raj confirms routing note and link fixes. Target: merge by EOD Friday. Any blockers?

raj (platform): No infra blockers. We'll coordinate with partners if they need the public partner page live before docs ship.

claire (security): No blockers from security. Approving the copy once it's in the PR.

ava (docs): Thanks team :white_check_mark: I'll push an updated commit in ~30m and add reviewers.
